<script>
function hideCheckBoxBasedOnStatut() {
    // Get all rows that contain the 'statut_demande' values
    var rows = document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
    
    rows.forEach(function(row) {
        // Get the 'statut_demande' value for the current row from the <td> with class "column_statut_demande"
        var statut = row.querySelector('.column_body.column_statut_demande').innerText.trim();
        
        // Get the checkbox element in the current row
        var checkbox = row.querySelector('.select_checkbox input[type="checkbox"]');
        
        // Condition to hide the checkbox if statut_demande is 'En cours de designation'
        console.log('satut',statut);
            if ((statut != 'A réenquêter')&&(statut !='A enquêter')) {
            checkbox.disabled  = 'true';  // Hide the checkbox
        } else {
            checkbox.style.display = '';  // Ensure checkbox is visible if condition is not met
        }
    });
}

// Call the function initially to hide checkboxes based on the current status
$(document).ready(function(){
    document.querySelector("#personnes_incluses_enquete_pmt > thead > tr > th.select_checkbox > label > input[type=checkbox]").disabled='true';
     document.querySelector("#personnes_incluses_enquete_pmt > thead > tr > th.select_checkbox > label > input[type=checkbox]").display='none';
    hideCheckBoxBasedOnStatut();
});

// Add a MutationObserver to detect changes in the table and reapply the logic
function observeTableChanges() {
    var tableBody = document.querySelector('tbody');

    if (tableBody) {
        // Create a MutationObserver instance
        var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutationsList, observer) {
            // Reapply the checkbox hiding logic when table body changes
            hideCheckBoxBasedOnStatut();
        });

        // Observe the table body for changes
        observer.observe(tableBody, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
}

// Start observing changes in the table body
observeTableChanges();
</script>

<script>
function hideCheckBoxBasedOnStatut() {
    // Get all rows that contain the 'statut_demande' values
    var rows = document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
    
    rows.forEach(function(row) {
        // Get the 'statut_demande' value for the current row from the <td> with class "column_statut_demande"
        var statut = row.querySelector('.column_body.column_statut_enquete').innerText.trim();
        
        // Get the checkbox element in the current row
        var checkbox = row.querySelector('.select_checkbox input[type="checkbox"]');
        
        // Condition to hide the checkbox if statut_demande is 'En cours de designation'
        if (statut === 'Vers validation communautaire'){
            checkbox.style.display = '';  // Hide the checkbox
        } else {
            checkbox.disabled='true';  // Ensure checkbox is visible if condition is not met
        }
    });
}

// Call the function initially to hide checkboxes based on the current status
$(document).ready(function(){
   document.querySelector("#liste_enquetes_pmt > thead > tr > th.select_checkbox > label > input[type=checkbox]").disabled='true';
     
    hideCheckBoxBasedOnStatut();
});

// Add a MutationObserver to detect changes in the table and reapply the logic
function observeTableChanges() {
    var tableBody = document.querySelector('tbody');

    if (tableBody) {
        // Create a MutationObserver instance
        var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutationsList, observer) {
            // Reapply the checkbox hiding logic when table body changes
            hideCheckBoxBasedOnStatut();
        });

        // Observe the table body for changes
        observer.observe(tableBody, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
}

// Start observing changes in the table body
observeTableChanges();
</script>
